name: Psyche Rembart
source:
A talented honors student at the academy and Phoron's best friend who later on becomes his co-worker at the Tsuge Office. Although he mainly plays a saxophone-like instrument, Rembart can also play the guitar and the piano. He is tall and handsome guy who is popular at his school, but due to him being the cool type, he tries to distance himself from romance.
